embedding_text:
非食品消费品安全与欧盟责任人
欧委会GPSR说明强调非食品消费品安全及境外产品的欧盟责任人安排，适用日期为2024年12月13日，仍需结合具体产品规则。
The Commission factsheet describes the GPSR framework for non-food consumer products, including an EU responsible person for products from outside the EU and application from 13 December 2024.
Keywords: GPSR, 欧盟责任人, 产品安全, consumer product, traceability
